name: Guess the Crop
tagline: Can you tell corn from soy from a satellite chip?
description: 30-second game. We show you a satellite-derived image chip of a field. You guess the crop. Built on USDA CDL ground truth — 8 pre-staged chips covering corn, soy, wheat, and sorghum. Score tally; play again. Chips in this build are placeholders; real Sentinel-2 RGB lands in Sprint 17.
